limitations: Final observed retweets, not a one-hour forecast.
Historical Twitter sample is not representative of Indian food-delivery complaints.
Indian geographic overlays are synthetic and excluded.
User-disjoint chronological evaluation also serves as grouped-user robustness evaluation.
Profile counters are snapshot metadata; publication-time provenance is unverified and may change after publication.
A narrow historical window cannot establish temporal generalization.
Cost ratio is a prototype assumption, not an empirically measured business cost.
Repost retweet_count may describe the source post and include engagement already present at repost publication; repost results are diagnostics only.
